# Elite World Estates

> Polish real estate agency in Spain, operating since 2018. Sells sea view apartments, villas, townhouses and luxury villas on the Costa Blanca and Costa del Sol. The team speaks Polish, German, English and Spanish. Slogan: "Home is your castle!"

Contact: +34 672 519 809 · info@eliteworldestates.com
